WildSpark 2.2.50 is a stable update for WoW Forever 1.60.1.

- Add WildMaps as a tab inside WildSpark, using the authorized Minimap Lens module source from Quantum Dungeon Tools (author: Alberto Gomez; upstream: https://github.com/bettogamer/QuantumDungeonTools).
- Enlarge the current minimap in place; adjust size and opacity, drag it to reposition, lock its position, or close it to restore its prior layout and zoom.
- Preserve the previous dungeon catalog WildMaps implementation and WildPvP in the repository archive for possible future restoration.

GitHub Actions built and checked the release package. Live in-game behavior and memory use were not measured.
